Resolves #20061

🌿 A merge's last word was green, and nothing that runs afterwards gets to say otherwise.

`review-admission-mergeability.yml` no longer runs on the PR's own `closed` event (the merge's `push: dev` already sweeps the board, anchored on the dev commit instead of the merged head), and a `publish` job that observes its PR closed or merged at any of its reads writes no status and does not fail; the merged head keeps the verdict it earned while open. One file, 27 insertions, 16 deletions; the per-PR concurrency, the poll bounds, the overflow cap and the `push` / `workflow_run` / `workflow_dispatch` triggers are untouched.

Not covered, inherited from #17692's API shape and 0 of the 52 measured items: `publish` awaits `getCombinedStatusForRef` after the job's last open read, so a close inside that await can still land one write on the merged head; so can the >32 overflow sweep's list-snapshot writes and the generic-error fallback. The AC-3 census records any such write under `#20022`.

Evidence: L2 (the committed `publish` script evaluated against a mocked GitHub, the YAML parsed, the five workflow-parsing unit specs green) → L4 required (AC-3: the first-five post-merge census). Residual: AC-3 census plus the publication-window, overflow and generic-error writes named above, Residual-Owner: #20022.

## Deltas from ticket
Reviewer boundary (Euclid, 14:14Z): the universal "no write after merge" is bounded to the observed-close guard; the publication window, the overflow sweep's snapshot writes and the generic-error fallback are named residuals under `#20022`, and `#20061`'s AC-3 and ledger are restated in place. The guard itself is a `PullClosed` sentinel thrown by `readPull` and returned on in the `catch`, so every read site (seed, poll, verify, final) is covered by one check instead of four.

[open, conflicting]               createCommitStatus=1 (failure @headsha) setFailed=0 info=0

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] AC-3, bounded: for the first five or more PRs merged after this lands, (a) no `pull_request_target` run anchored on the merged head is created after `mergedAt` (the closed-event trigger is gone; a run queued before the close may still start after it), (b) no `Review Admission Mergeability` check run on the head concludes red with a start after `mergedAt` (a late start that ends green on `PullClosed` is recorded, not counted), and (c) any `review-admission/mergeability` status created after `mergedAt` is a publication-window, overflow or generic-error write, recorded with its run id as the residual (the ticket's Context query); census posted on `#20061`, the row and the residual on `#20022`.
